title: Even the wise differ
explanation: The repetition makes disagreement unsurprising: several thinkers need not arrive at one view. The line can loosen a conversation that has stalled because each side expects complete agreement. It does not tell us that all opinions are equally well supported, or that a decision can be avoided forever. Rather, in our reading, it creates a little room to hear why people differ before choosing what to do. The dictionary supplies “different opinions” and this example; it identifies no particular sages or dispute.
meaning_odia: ମୁନି ଅନେକ ହେଲେ ମତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅନେକ ହୋଇପାରେ। “ନାନା”ର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତିରେ ମତଭେଦକୁ ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟର କଥା ନ କରି ସହଜ ଭାବେ କୁହାଯାଏ। ସମସ୍ତେ ଏକ କଥା କହିବା ଦରକାର ବୋଲି ଜିଦ୍ ଧରିଥିବା ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଏହା ଟିକିଏ ଅବକାଶ ଆଣିପାରେ। ତଥାପି କେଉଁ ମତ ପଛରେ କି ଯୁକ୍ତି ଅଛି, ସେହି ବିଚାର କରିବାର କାମ ରହିଯାଏ।
english_summary: Disagreement can remain even among thoughtful people.
odia_summary: ବିଚାରଶୀଳ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ମତଭେଦ ରହିପାରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: Three experienced readers propose different endings for a play. The director smiles, quotes the saying, and asks each to explain what their ending would achieve before the group chooses.
cultural_context: No named sages, scriptural derivation or origin established. Acceptance of disagreement is an editorial application, not a claim that all claims are equally true.
